noExercises: No exercises left. Add one of the classic breathings again, or make your own.
deepDesc: An easy way to relax and let your worries go. Also called belly breathing, it helps ease stress and can lower your blood pressure.
continuousDesc: A technique used by singers and wind players to keep a steady tone. It helps you keep sound going for long periods.
boxDesc: Used by athletes, nurses and others who need to stay calm under pressure. Good for meditation and for reducing stress.
equalDesc: Breathe in for as long as you breathe out. A smooth and steady breath can bring balance and calm.
relaxDesc: A pattern that aims to reduce anxiety and help you get to sleep.
rhythmicDesc: A simple technique for beginners, suitable for anyone who can breathe without difficulty.
inhaleMin: Breathing in needs at least one second.
partRange: Each part is between 0 and {max} seconds.
name: Name
logHint: <breathing> is the exercise, <repeats> the breaths, <minutes> the time.
soundHint: A tone when you breathe in and when you breathe out.
vibrationHint: On the devices that can vibrate, at each change of breath.
infoAbout1: Guided breathing with a circle that grows as you breathe in and shrinks as you breathe out. A dot goes round the ring over each breath, so you always know where you are.
infoAbout2: The six classic breathings are the ones of Nomie Breathe v1. Make your own with any lengths for the four parts of a breath.
infoBefore: Find a comfortable position and breathe through your nose. You get three seconds to get ready before the first breath.
deleteBody: “{name}” is removed from your exercises. Your history is kept.
clearBody: The sessions you finished are removed from the plugin. Your timeline is not changed.
endBody: What you finished so far is kept in your history.
logEntryDefault: Just finished <breathing> exercise with total of <repeats> repeats taking <minutes>.
